summary: The customer wants to assess whether a fiber-based optical measurement installed in a tablet press feed frame can monitor API concentration changes in real time.

facts_stated.text: The customer manufactures tablets from a powder blend containing an API and excipients.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We manufacture tablets from a powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients.

facts_stated.text: Laboratory checks currently verify whether the blend is on target, but results are delayed until after the material moves through the press.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Laboratory checks tell us whether the blend is on target, but results arrive after the material has moved through the press.

facts_stated.text: A first pilot is planned to compare viable measurement options prior to procuring production equipment.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Our first pilot should compare reasonable measurement options before we commit to production equipment.

heterogeneous.enquiry_quote: powder blend containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and excipients

customer_premises.claim: A fiber-based optical measurement can be installed directly in the feed frame to reliably track API concentration changes.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: a fiber based measurement in the feed frame could follow API concentration changes

unknowns: Specific chemical identities and optical spectra of the API and excipients
Nominal API concentration and expected dynamic range of variation
Powder physical characteristics such as particle size distribution and flow behavior
Feed frame design, clearance, paddle movement, and available optical interface or window ports
Risk and extent of powder fouling or window adhesion in the feed frame
Required measurement accuracy, precision, and response time or sampling frequency
Distance between the feed frame and the analyzer location
